_comment: SPL used to collect context for Jev. {value}/{short} are replaced with escaped entities. Data locations come from the macros jev_cloudtrail and jev_endpoint (set them in local/macros.conf). Source IP counts ignore AWS service principals and "AWS Internal" (not client addresses). readOnly from CloudTrail decides read vs change when present.
identity: | inputlookup identity_lookup_expanded | search identity="{value}" | head 1 | eval hosts=mvfilter(match(identity,"\$$")) | eval hosts=mvmap(hosts, replace(hosts,"\$$","")) | table category bunit priority watchlist hosts
asset: | inputlookup asset_lookup_by_str | search key="{value}" OR dns="{value}" OR nt_host="{short}" | head 1 | table category priority bunit is_expected
cloud_user: search `jev_cloudtrail` userIdentity.userName="{value}" | eval ip=if(match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9.]+$") OR match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9a-fA-F:]+:[0-9a-fA-F:]*$"), sourceIPAddress, null()), svc=if(isnull(ip), sourceIPAddress, null()) | eval write=case(readOnly="true",0, readOnly="false",1, match(eventName,"^(Describe|Get|List|Lookup|Search|BatchGet|Head)"),0, true(),1), iam=if(match(eventName,"^(Create|Delete|Update)(User|AccessKey|LoginProfile)"),eventName,null()) | eval launch=if(eventName="RunInstances",1,0) | stats count sum(launch) as launches dc(ip) as source_ips values(ip) as ip_list values(svc) as via_services dc(awsRegion) as regions sum(write) as write_calls values(iam) as iam_changes
change_actor: search `jev_cloudtrail` eventName="{value}" | stats count by userIdentity.userName userAgent | sort - count | head 3 | rename userIdentity.userName as actor
auth_outcome: | tstats count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.src="{value}" by Authentication.action | rename Authentication.action as action
traffic_outcome: | tstats count from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.src="{value}" by All_Traffic.action | rename All_Traffic.action as action
endpoint_powershell: search `jev_endpoint` host="{short}*" (process_name="powershell.exe" OR Image="*powershell.exe" OR CommandLine="*powershell*") | eval cmd=lower(coalesce(CommandLine, process, cmdline)) | stats count as total count(eval(match(cmd,"-enc|-encodedcommand|-w hidden|-w 1 |frombase64|downloadstring|iex "))) as suspicious
related_alerts: search `notable` | search ({clauses}) NOT event_id="{event_id}" | stats values(rule_name) as rules
cloud_user_baseline: search `jev_cloudtrail` userIdentity.userName="{value}" | eval ip=if(match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9.]+$") OR match(sourceIPAddress,"^[0-9a-fA-F:]+:[0-9a-fA-F:]*$"), sourceIPAddress, null()), svc=if(isnull(ip), sourceIPAddress, null()) | stats count values(ip) as ip_list dc(awsRegion) as regions
rollup_window: search `notable` | search ({clauses}) notable_type=notable NOT rule_name="*Risk Threshold*" NOT rule_name="*Finding Group*" | stats min(info_min_time) as e max(info_max_time) as l count
rollup_contributors: search index=risk risk_object="{value}" | stats count values(command) as commands values(source) as rules
change_window: search `notable` | search command="{value}" | stats min(info_min_time) as e max(info_max_time) as l count
